attacks.target: n8, n1, d1, r3, r2, e3, slots
attacks.claim: A common case is not handled: the mother who held custody has died and the father claims the children from the maternal grandmother or aunt who keeps them. The Supreme Court holds that custody then passes to the father automatically, by force of law, and is lost only if he is shown unfit. The record has no slot for the mother's death. It would warn n8 (the mother's priority to rebut), warn n1 (custody already decided: 'a transfer claim, not this one') and count d1 from a divorce judgment that may be years old, so the lapse warns. All three answers are wrong for this case. r3 housing and the defendant-is-the-ex-spouse framing also do not fit.

source.what: Supreme Court, family and inheritance chamber, file 1177332, decision of 07-03-2018 (Family Code arts. 62, 64). Same principle in file 1193605 of 09-05-2018, file 1204336 of 04-07-2018 ('بقوة القانون'), file 1252089 of 03-10-2018, file 1248029 of 07-11-2018 and file 0987930 of 08-06-2016. In file 1228512 of 05-09-2018 the court said that custody passes to the father as a single, indivisible right and, by the site's summary, that the custody rules of the divorce chapter do not govern this case. File 1170839 of 07-03-2018 adds that guardianship goes with custody ('الولاية مقرونة بالحضانة'). File 1220547 of 05-09-2018 holds that a maternal grandmother has no claim to housing or rent under art. 72. All were read on coursupreme.dz.

attacks.quoteArabic: تنتقل الحضانة بعد وفاة الام للاب تلقائيا و أن هذا الحق لا يخرج عنه الا إذا ثبت أنه غير أهل للقيام بواجب الرعاية و التربية. / تسند الحضانة للأب بعد وفاة الأم بقوة القانون، ولا يمكن إسقاطها عنه إلا إذا أثبت أنه غير أهل لذلك (1204336) / تعود الحضانة للأب بوفاة الأم وهي غير قابلة للتجزئة (1228512)
attacks.consequence: The record should ask whether the mother is alive. n8 should fire only when she is alive; its tellingFacts already say so, but its 'when' tests plaintiff_parent alone. When she has died: n8 and the n1 'transfer' boundary should not send the father outside; d1 should not count from the divorce judgment; the defendant is the relative who keeps the child; r3 (art. 72 housing) does not apply to a grandmother. Examples are needed for this case.

attacks.claim: The record says no text gives a route to custody between spouses who are not divorced (o3: 'no text expressly bars'; n3: 'check the basis'). The CPCA has one. A parent may bring an urgent action to end or provisionally withdraw the other parent's exercise of guardianship over the child, and in it the judge may provisionally give custody to one parent. That route has its own court (the place where guardianship is exercised), a hearing in chambers, a 30-day service period on pain of the order lapsing, and a 15-day appeal. The record mentions none of these.

source.what: Law 08-09 (CPCA), Official Journal 2008 issue 21, arts. 453 ¶1, 455 ¶1, 456 ¶2, 458 ¶1-2 and 460 ¶2 (book II, family section, 'في الولاية على نفس القاصر'). Quoted from the article store's text of this issue (version law-08-09). The page was not re-read in this pass. The ledger lists no later amendment of these articles (law 22-13 does not touch them).

attacks.quoteArabic: يقدم طلب إنهاء ممارسة الولاية على القاصر أو سحبها المؤقت، من قبل أحد الوالدين أو ممثل النيابة العامة أو من قبل كل من يهمه الأمر بدعوى استعجالية. / كما يجوز له أن يسند مؤقتا حضانة القاصر لأحد الأبوين، وإذا تعذر ذلك تسند لأحد الأشخاص المبينين في قانون الأسرة. / يتم التبليغ الرسمي للأمر الاستعجالي الصادر وفقا للمادة 453 أعلاه، من طرف الخصم الذي يهمه التعجيل إلى باقي الخصوم خلال ثلاثين (30) يوما من تاريخ النطق به، تحت طائلة سقوط الأمر.
attacks.consequence: n3 and o3 should point to this route when there is no divorce: an urgent action before the court of the place where guardianship is exercised (458), heard in chambers. They should show its own deadlines: service within 30 days of the order or the order lapses (455), and appeal within 15 days (456). Its relief is provisional custody, not an award on the merits.

attacks.claim: Family Code 65 ¶1 lets the judge extend a boy's custody to 16 when the custodian is a mother who has not remarried. The record has no request for this extension. The slot child_past_custody_age asks only whether a boy has reached ten, and n4 then sends the case 'outside: custody-period-ended'. Take a mother who has not remarried and claims her 11-year-old son: the record calls her case out of scope, when the right answer is an award with a request to extend.

source.what: Family Code (law 84-11), art. 65 ¶1, as held in the article store (version law-84-11, unchanged at the cut-off), the record's own b4. Issue and page as in the store; the page was not re-read in this pass.

attacks.quoteArabic: وللقاضي أن يمدد الحضانة بالنسبة للذكر إلى (16) سنة إذا كانت الحاضنة أما لم تتزوج ثانية.
attacks.consequence: For a boy aged 10 to 16 whose plaintiff is a mother who has not remarried (plaintiff_parent = mother and plaintiff_remarried_non_mahram = no), n4 should not send the case outside. The record should offer a request to extend custody to 16 and ask for the facts on the child's interest (65 ¶2).

attacks.claim: The Supreme Court reads art. 72 more narrowly than r3 and e5 do. Giving the marital home for custody depends on the husband agreeing to it, and the court says art. 72 gives the custodian no right to stay in that home. If the father offers suitable housing, the right to rent falls whether or not the mother lives there. A rent award may be made without first ordering housing when the father showed no readiness to provide it. r3 asks for the plaintiff to stay in the marital home until execution as if that were part of the request. e5 never asks whether the father offered suitable housing, which is the fact that decides the rent.

source.what: Supreme Court, family and inheritance chamber, file 0973124, decision of 04-05-2016 (Family Code art. 72). Also file 1365731 of 07-10-2020 (art. 72 as amended by ordinance 05-02): https://coursupreme.dz/decision/%d9%85%d9%84%d9%81-%d8%b1%d9%82%d9%85-1365731-%d9%82%d8%b1%d8%a7%d8%b1-%d8%a8%d8%aa%d8%a7%d8%b1%d9%8a%d8%ae-07-10-2020/ ; and file 0937015 of 06-01-2016. The tension with 72 ¶2 (stay in the marital home until the housing judgment is carried out) is unresolved by these pages.

attacks.quoteArabic: يحكم للحاضنة ببدل الإيجار لأن طلب تخصيص مسكن الزوجية لممارسة الحضانة يتوقف على موافقة الزوج. / لا تشترط المادة 72 من قانون الأسرة توفير المسكن الزوجي لممارسة الحضانة ولا تنص على حق الحاضنة في البقاء فيه. / يسقط حق الحاضنة في بدل الإيجار، إذا كان السكن الموفر من الأب ملائما لممارسة الحضانة، سواء أقامت فيه أو امتنعت.
attacks.consequence: e5 should ask whether the father offered housing and whether it was suitable, because rent fails if he did. r3 should not present staying in the marital home as a settled right: it should show 72 ¶2 next to this case law. o8 should note that the marital home cannot be imposed without the husband's consent.

attacks.claim: The Supreme Court let a mother claim custody again years after she had waived it in a consensual divorce, because the children were in fact with her and she justified the claim. This supports d1's reading 3: there is no lapse while the plaintiff actually has the children. It cuts against the protective reading, which counts the year from the divorce judgment. In rc1 (children with the mother for a year after the divorce) the record would warn that her right lapsed. It would also send this mother's claim 'outside: custody-transfer' through n1, while the court treated it as her claim to custody under arts. 64 and 71.

source.what: Supreme Court, family and inheritance chamber, file 1453870, decision of 06-10-2021 (Family Code arts. 64 and 71); custody waived in a 2016 consensual divorce. The decision page does not cite art. 68.

attacks.quoteArabic: يحق للأم المطالبة بالحضانة من جديد، بعد تنازلها عنها أثناء الطلاق بالتراضي، متى برّرت طلبها وكانت الحضانة الفعلية عندها.
attacks.consequence: d1 should ask whether the children are in fact living with the plaintiff and not warn of a lapse while they are. Where the earlier judgment recorded the plaintiff's own waiver and the children are in fact with her, n1 should treat the claim as a renewed claim under arts. 66, 71 and 64, not as another party's transfer claim.

attacks.target: d1 (reading 5), b3, b5, b10, e3, k4, o7
attacks.claim: The child protection law makes the child's best interest the required aim of every judicial decision taken about a child, and lists what the judge weighs: sex, age, health, moral, intellectual, emotional and physical needs, and family surroundings. It also bars separating a child from the family except by a judicial decision when the child's best interest requires it. The record relies only on the Family Code's 'مراعاة مصلحة المحضون'. It labels as merely interpretive the reading that the art. 68 lapse yields to the child's interest, and leaves open (o7) when that interest overrides the order of art. 64. Neither the elements nor the facts to state ask for the art. 7 factors.

source.what: Law 15-12 of 15 July 2015 on the protection of the child, Official Journal 2015 issue 39 (19 July 2015), page 6, arts. 4 and 7; art. 2 (page 5-6) defines the child as under 18 and lists the custodian among the child's legal representatives.

attacks.quoteArabic: يجب أن تكون المصلحة الفضلى للطفل الغاية من كل إجراء أو تدبير أو حكم أو قرار قضائي أو إداري يتخذ بشأنه. يؤخذ بعين الاعتبار، في تقدير المصلحة الفضلى للطفل، لا سيما جنسه وسنه وصحته واحتياجاته المعنوية والفكرية والعاطفية والبدنية و وسطه العائلي وجميع الجوانب المرتبطة بوضعه.
attacks.consequence: Cite law 15-12 art. 7 as binding basis next to Family Code 64, 65 ¶2 and 67 ¶3. Ground d1's reading 5 and o7 on it. Add the art. 7 factors to e3's facts to state.

attacks.claim: k26 and k58 say no stored text lets the child be heard in a custody claim, and place hearing the minor only in the guardianship procedure. The general rules on witness proof say otherwise. A minor who has reached discernment may be heard by way of information. In personal-status cases, relatives normally barred as witnesses may be heard, except descendants, so the children cannot testify as witnesses but may only be heard by way of information. The Supreme Court has also held that a child without discernment has no say in choosing the custodian.

source.what: Law 08-09 (CPCA), Official Journal 2008 issue 21, art. 153 ¶4-5, quoted from the article store's text (version law-08-09); page not re-read. Supporting tier 2: Supreme Court file 1072148, decision of 03-05-2017 (Family Code art. 64), coursupreme.dz.

attacks.quoteArabic: غير أن الأشخاص المذكورين في هذه المادة، باستثناء الفروع، يجوز سماعهم في القضايا الخاصة بحالة الأشخاص والطلاق. / يجوز سماع القصر الذين بلغوا سن التمييز على سبيل الاستدلال. / لا يعتد برغبة الطفل غير المميز في اختيار من يحضنه
attacks.consequence: k26 and k58 should cite CPCA 153 ¶4-5: a child of discernment may be heard for information, and relatives other than descendants may be witnesses on the facts of e3.

attacks.claim: k19 says no stored text says how the custody file reaches the public prosecutor, and k47 says the prosecutor's role creates no step for the petition. CPCA 260 requires cases on the protection of persons lacking full capacity to be communicated to the prosecutor at least 10 days before the hearing, and lets the judge order communication of any other case. Family Code 3 مكرر already makes the prosecutor a principal party in every Family Code case. A custody claim concerns minors, so it arguably falls under 260 ¶6.

source.what: Law 08-09 (CPCA), Official Journal 2008 issue 21, art. 260 ¶1, ¶6 and ¶11, quoted from the article store's text (version law-08-09); page not re-read. Whether a custody claim is 'protection of persons lacking capacity' is a reading. Tier-3 lead, from memory and not verified: practice serves the petition on the prosecutor's office in family cases, by analogy with cpca 438.

attacks.quoteArabic: يجب إبلاغ النيابة العامة عشرة (10) أيام على الأقل قبل تاريخ الجلسة بالقضايا الآتية: ... 5 - حماية ناقصي الأهلية، ... يمكن أيضا للقاضي تلقائيا، أن يأمر بإبلاغ ممثل النيابة العامة بأية قضية أخرى.
attacks.consequence: k19 should cite CPCA 260 and tell the lawyer to make sure the file is communicated to the prosecutor (and named as a party under 3 مكرر), instead of stating that no text says how.

attacks.claim: The Supreme Court states that custody is in principle not divided between siblings. It partly quashed a decision that had split the children (file 1053458). r1 and e2 let the lawyer claim custody of some children and not others with no warning.

source.what: Supreme Court, family and inheritance chamber, file 1053458, decision of 01-02-2017 (Family Code arts. 62, 64). The words 'الأصل في الحضانة عدم تجزئتها' are from the site's reasoning as summarised by the fetch, not the headnote, and should be checked on the page. Also file 1228512 of 05-09-2018, headnote 'وهي غير قابلة للتجزئة'.

attacks.quoteArabic: تعود الحضانة للأب بوفاة الأم وهي غير قابلة للتجزئة.
attacks.consequence: When the claim covers only some of the children, the record should warn that splitting siblings goes against the court's principle, and ask why.
